SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_2q_chronic(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(7) DEFAULT 0,

	1519_1B130 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  1519_1B131 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  2059_1B130 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	2059_1B131 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  60_1B0280 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	60_1B0281 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_2q_chronic WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_2q_chronic (
SELECT @id,h.hoscode
,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
	,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543

,COUNT(DISTINCT  IF(p.age_y >=15,p.cid,NULL)) target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_1519 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B130')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1519_1B130 
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_1519 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B131') ,t.cid,NULL)) 1519_1B131

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_2059 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B130') ,t.cid,NULL)) 2059_1B130
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_2059 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B131') ,t.cid,NULL)) 2059_1b131

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0280') ,t.cid,NULL)) 60_1B0280 
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0281') ,t.cid,NULL)) 60_1B0281

FROM  t_person_cid p 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN (SELECT cid,GROUP_CONCAT(DIAGCODE ORDER BY DIAGCODE) g_chronic FROM t_chronic GROUP BY cid) 
  AS c ON p.cid=c.cid 
LEFT JOIN tmp_labor l ON p.cid=l.cid AND l.bdate BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_2q t  ON p.cid=t.cid AND t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) AND ISNULL(l.cid) 
GROUP BY h.hoscode
);
rows.aname: จำนวนประชากรในเขตรับผิดชอบกลุ่มโรคเรื้อรัง ได้รับคัดกรองโรคซึมเศร้า (2Q)
rows.bname: จำนวนประชากรในเขตรับผิดชอบกลุ่มโรคเรื้อรัง(คน)
rows.notice:
รหัสการการคัดกรองโรคซึมเศร้า (2Q) แบ่งตามกลุ่มอายุดังนี้
- อายุ 15-59 ปี รหัส SPECIALPP 1B130=>ปกติ,1B131=>ผิดปกติ
- อายุ 60 ปีขั้นไป รหัส SPECIALPP 1B0280=>ปกติ,1B0281=>ผิดปกติ
สำหรับรายงานนี้ จะไม่รวมการคัดกรองในกลุ่มหญิงตั้งครรภ์
สำหรับกลุ่มโรคเรื้อรัง ต้องใช้ Smart Card โปรดใช้วิจารณญาณในการใช้ข้อมูล
rows.indiv_sql:
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx(
SELECT p.hospcode, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA,p.DISCHARGE
,c.g_chronic
,t.DATE_SERV,t.PPSPECIAL
,t.PPSPLACE,t.HOSPCODE as input_hosp
,t.PROVIDER
,t.age_y
,IF(((t.age_1519 =1 OR t.age_2059=1)  AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B130','1B131')) 
OR (t.age_60 =1 AND  t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0280','1B0281'))   ,'ได้รับการคัดกรอง','' ) AS result
FROM  t_person_cid p 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN (SELECT cid,GROUP_CONCAT(DIAGCODE ORDER BY DIAGCODE) g_chronic FROM t_chronic GROUP BY cid) 
  AS c ON p.cid=c.cid 
LEFT JOIN tmp_labor AS l ON p.cid=l.cid  AND bdate BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_2q t  ON p.cid=t.cid AND t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) AND ISNULL(l.cid)
 AND p.age_y >=15
);
SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
, d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA,d.DISCHARGE
,d.g_chronic
,d.DATE_SERV,d.PPSPECIAL
,d.PPSPLACE,d.input_hosp
,d.PROVIDER,d.age_y,d.result
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("1519_1b130"+"1519_1b131"+"2059_1b130"+"2059_1b131"+"60_1b0280"+"60_1b0281") as "result" ,SUM("1519_1b130") as "1519_1b130" ,SUM("1519_1b131") as "1519_1b131" ,SUM("2059_1b130") as "2059_1b130" ,SUM("2059_1b131") as "2059_1b131" ,SUM("60_1b0280") as "60_1b0280" ,SUM("60_1b0281") as "60_1b0281"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
